values.summary: Added typed Deepgram batch synthesis and prerecorded transcription support with canonical profiles, redacted provenance, deterministic loopback proof, one bounded live canary, and downstream Podcast Studio guidance.
actual_changes: Added typed synthesis/transcription requests, results, media settings, provenance, stable errors, and a speech-provider factory.
Added Deepgram Aura-2 Pluto and Nova-3 profiles without implying text-completion support.
Restricted live credentials to per-request environment or external key-file resolution and official Deepgram endpoints.
Added deterministic loopback tests plus a redacted Pluto/Nova-3 live receipt.
Documented provider setup and Podcast Studio consumption without duplicating HTTP or credential ownership.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove typed profiles, TTS/STT construction, WAV and MP3 media contracts, parsing, redaction, endpoint restriction, stable errors, malformed responses, and timeout behavior; 8 passed, 1 ignored, 0 failed.
Prove a live Aura-2 Pluto synthesis and Nova-3 prerecorded transcription round trip with normalized expected-phrase match and a metadata-only redacted receipt; 1 passed, 0 failed.
Reject type, ownership, error-handling, and dead-code warnings in the bounded provider library surface.
Reject malformed whitespace and confirm the operator Deepgram credential value is absent from tracked and untracked issue files.

Prove deterministic Deepgram configuration, credential, and request-validation branches while satisfying the changed-source per-file coverage gate; 10 passed, 1 ignored, 0 failed, deepgram.rs 422/510 lines (82.745 percent).
